speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked	the Minister for National Development in view of complaints by owners of HDB BTO projects, how does HDB ensure the quality of its flats and what recourse do owners have when defects have not been rectified to their satisfaction.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: First, HDB engages consultants with full-time staff onsite to supervise the construction works.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The consultants will set up a supervision system at the site at the beginning of the building project.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Second, HDB keeps a list of recommended building materials and equipment suppliers to prevent the use of sub-standard materials or equipment.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Third, HDB takes a systematic approach to deliver buildings of high structural quality, such as checking that the building piles are constructed to the correct depth.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Fourth, HDB requires the contractor to provide timber mock-ups for the toilets, kitchens, air-con ledges and service yards to be constructed.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This will help HDB identify potential design, safety and maintenance issues, and get the contractor to resolve these issues upfront before construction begins.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Fifth, HDB requires samples of actual units to be constructed for each different flat type in the project.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Once these sample units are approved, they serve as the benchmark of quality for the entire project.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Sixth, HDB conducts regular audits and deploys its Central Audit Team to perform focused process checks at different stages of construction.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Seventh, HDB's Project Directors also make regular checks on the works for compliance with approved drawings, specifications and work methods.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Eighth, all flats, when completed, will have to pass the handover inspection by HDB.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Finishes and fittings are inspected for proper installation and compliance with the required standard.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: All visible defects found by the inspection team will be rectified before handover.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Ninth, HDB conducts functional tests to check on the mechanical and electrical services installed as well as the water-tightness of bathrooms, windows and external walls.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: During this period, the contractor will be obliged to rectify any other defects that are detected.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The BSC will operate for a year on site so that residents have sufficient time to submit their feedback.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: All feedback to the BSC are monitored closely to ensure defects are rectified in a timely manner and to an acceptable quality standard.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The rectification works will be inspected and certified by HDB's supervising consultant before a joint inspection with the owners is arranged to hand over the unit.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: HDB will get the contractor to rectify the defects in accordance with acceptable industry norms.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: An objective assessment of the quality of HDB flats is the BCA's Construction Quality Assessment System (CONQUAS) score.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is the industry standard to measure the quality of building projects.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is comparable to that of private developments.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This reflects HDB's push to secure high quality and workmanship standards for its flats.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: While the situation has improved, HDB is continually looking at ways to do better.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: It will continue to seek improvement in its design, choice of material and construction to improve the quality of its flats.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: When this happens, such information not just helps educate the owners on industry norms and standards, but would also better manage expectations.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: The CONQUAS score reflects three components: architectural merit, which is what the Member is concerned about, quality of finish and the build quality; as well as two other components, such as structure and M&E.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: CONQUAS score for each development, each BTO already reflects the standard, albeit in a numerical nature.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Each BSC will typically receive one-third of the residents approaching them for various issues: complaints, defects as well as requests for information.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: About 25% of them relate, for example, to water flow.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: This is because there are water management and flow requirements at the input.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: The remainder relate to a variety of issues that reflect build quality and other areas.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Many of these can be solved and HDB's BSC staff continue to work on this.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: Can I just check and clarify what recourse does a resident have if the defects were reported within the DLP period, but rectified not to the satisfaction of the resident and the defects continue to persist?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: For specific cases, let us have a look at them.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: HDB will do what is appropriate and right in the circumstances.

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: They know that if they can drag further, the likelihood is that the owners will just accept the defects.

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: The HDB officers are just not able to cope with them.

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: Manpower resource is a problem and they may not be empowered to do some of the things to rectify certain defects.

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: The contractor will again try to use the default response and push back and say, "No, it could be due to some other things".

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: How do we help the new owners so that they have a positive experience moving into the new flats?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Of course, if the defect needs more work, on exceptional basis, these would take more time.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: If the Member or his residents are aware of these incidences where they feel that the contractors are dragging their feet, alert the BSC and HDB, and he can alert us.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: As for the capacity of HDB branch offices and BSCs to cope with the number of issues that are raised, let us know which areas are of concern.
